title: M5 resolved plant care and reagent mutation
acceptance_criteria: Resolved inherited care defaults drive live ordinary tray polling in upstream order with exact thresholds and one-unit drain; initial mutation level below 25 blocks all effects/drain, while a batch crossing 25 completes.
Effect scale precedes probability and guards; min-scale uses exact dose and does not bypass earlier threshold/eligibility checks.
Buffered levels apply on ordinary poll; health/death effects are immediate and later effects respect dead-plant guards.
Potency and robustness mutations preserve unrelated resolved fields and never change harvest yield/output or consume mutation RNG.
Five typed effects (Cryoxadone, AffectGrowth, Diethylamine, Phalanximine, RestoreSeeds) and forced evaluator cycle follow resolved upstream algorithms.
Genetic copies retain species, packet/product, all chemistry/gas maps, mutation targets, unrelated fields, and holder state.

Eight native cases exercise ordinary poll and resolved effects, including mutation-level admission, exact 399/400-cent boundary, and ordered effects; existing mutation and authenticated batch regressions remain selected.
Main, JVM-test, and native sources compile and runtime jar is produced.
Report unsupported Kudzu and popup presentation, five targetless production species profiles, open 65-family assets, and incomplete catalog/special-trait coverage.
Report bounded M5 coverage, not full showcase/catalog, full suite, visual/client review, or owner acceptance.
manual_steps: Existing `/ms14 botany_fixture` care station remains partial; this revision has no complete every-effect showcase. No repeated gas test is requested; full catalog/mutation showcase and owner acceptance remain outstanding.
